micro_value_props: Rhino-Rack's famous battle tested Pioneer platform has been improved again with the 6 series
Maximize your roof carrying capabilities, for 4x4, trade or everyday use and upgrade your lifestyle
With additional East-West channels for even more accessory mounting options
The widest range of accessories available for every activity from kayaking to off-road adventures
Improvements include 60% less drag, 20% less weight and 25% more channels
Enhanced powder coating for diamond-like durability to take more use and abuse
long_description: Rhino-Rack's design philosophy when it comes to their roof rack development is centred around the goal of upgrading lifestyles not just vehicles. The ubiquitous Pioneer platform is a perfect representation of this idea with its amazing versatility, custom vehicle fits, and a carefully considered approach to design and construction. It's a brilliant roof rack for 4x4 adventures, camping, road trips, cycling excursions, water sports enthusiasts, tradies, or simply for day-to-day hauling. Just when we thought it couldn't get any better Rhino-Rack pulled yet another ace from their sleeves with the 6 series Pioneer platform range, with a host of upgrades to improve an already excellent roof rack system. For the 6 series Rhino listened to their customer feedback and improved the Pioneer platform to suit. Arguably the most impactful upgrade is the 60% reduction in drag, which means less wind noise primarily, one of the biggest issues with any roof rack. This also will slightly improve fuel economy on long trips. Weight is always another high impact issue with roof racks and especially platforms, as with the greater load space comes greater weight, which means you can load up less gear before reaching your vehicle's roof load rating limit. With the 6 series Rhino have reduced the weight of the platform by a very substantial 20%, so you can carry more gear. Amazingly, this has been achieved without any reduction in the rack's strength with the use of stronger alloys. Rhino have also improved the durability of the already tough Pioneer range with a new powder coating technique to produce the toughest finish ever, so you'll be very hard pressed to damage or scuff this rack. Everyone wants more accessory mounting options, so they have done away with channel apertures which allows 100% of the platform's channels to be used for mounting accessories. Along with a 25% increase in the amount of channels for accessory mounting it now provides you with the option to fit your accessories to almost any part of the platform. An area where Rhino have always shined is in their range of accessories available for their Pioneer range, this remains unchanged. With accessories for every activity, whether you are into 4x4 trips, kayaking, camping, cycling, or if you're a tradesperson, they have something for you. Plus, they have various general cargo carrying options for the 6 series. Rhino have also made innovations in this area with improved designs across the board and their new Zwifloc channel nuts which allow you to fit, move, or remove your accessories easily, without needing to shift any of the others you may have fitted. Note that to fit a Pioneer platform on your vehicle you'll need other components to provide a customized solution specific to your make and model. To see if there's a 6 series platform suitable for your vehicle please try out our online vehicle fitment tool to find a complete roof rack setup.

Key Cover — 3 Years of Nationwide Support — lost your rack keys on the road? Your Gold Guarantee includes Key Cover for 3 years, with up to 2 replacement keys per year.
